skill.summary: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the find-skills-wzr-999 skill.
- Enables users to discover and install agent skills based on their queries or interests.
- Provides guidance on when and how to use the skill to search, present, and install agent skills.
- Includes recommended search strategies, example commands, and tips for finding relevant skills.
- Offers suggestions when no matching skills are found and guidance for creating new skills.
- Links to the open agent skills ecosystem at https://skills.sh/.
